Trade.SelectItemPrompt: Select an item from STATION INVENTORY
Trade.DescriptionIce: Frozen water harvested from asteroids and comets. Raw material for water and fuel production.
Trade.DescriptionIronOre: Unrefined iron ore. The primary raw material for smelting steel.
Trade.DescriptionSilicon: Silicon extracted from silicate rock. Used in electronics and solar panel manufacturing.
Trade.DescriptionMagnesiumOre: Magnesium ore — a lightweight structural metal used in shipbuilding.
Trade.DescriptionUraniumOre: Uranium ore with a high concentration of radioactive isotopes. Raw material for energy cell production.
Trade.DescriptionCarbonOre: Carbon ore mined from asteroid belts. Used in chemical processing and protein mass production.
Trade.DescriptionWater: Purified water. Required for the life-support systems of stations and ships.
Trade.DescriptionSteel: A durable iron-based structural alloy. Forms the hulls of ships and station modules.
Trade.DescriptionEnergyCells: Compact energy storage cells refined from processed uranium. Power a ship's onboard systems.
Trade.DescriptionFuel: Propellant for main engines. Refuels directly into the ship's tanks.
Trade.DescriptionProteinMass: Synthesized protein mass — raw material for producing food rations.
Trade.DescriptionFoodRations: Ready-to-eat food rations for the crew. Consumed over time during flight.
Trade.DescriptionElectronics: Control blocks for station systems and ship equipment.
